description: This file implements a mock host resolver for testing purposes within the Chromium networking code. It includes classes for request handling, cache management, rule-based resolution, and DNS listener simulation, with extensive use of Chromium base and net libraries.

classes.name: MockHostResolverBase
classes.description: A mock implementation of a host resolver for testing, supporting rule-based resolution, caching, and request management.

classes.name: MockHostResolverFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of MockHostResolverBase with specific rules and caching options.

classes.name: RuleBasedHostResolverProc
classes.description: A rule-based host resolver procedure allowing custom hostname resolution rules for testing.

classes.name: HangingHostResolver
classes.description: A mock resolver that simulates hanging or delayed responses, used for testing cancellation and timeout scenarios.

classes.name: ScopedDefaultHostResolverProc
classes.description: A RAII class to set and restore the default host resolver procedure within a scope.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a new host resolution request for a given host or URL scheme host port.

methods.name: CreateMdnsListener
methods.description: Creates an mDNS listener for a specified host and query type.

methods.name: LoadIntoCache
methods.description: Preloads cache with specified host resolution results.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Performs host resolution, either synchronously or asynchronously.

methods.name: ResolveFromIPLiteralOrCache
methods.description: Resolves a host from an IP literal or cache.

methods.name: ResolveNow
methods.description: Triggers immediate resolution of a pending request.

methods.name: DetachRequest
methods.description: Detaches and cancels a pending request by ID.
